$note: 官祿宮（2026-10-12）：天梁.官祿。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 官祿宮 p.530–560。殉職、牢獄、官非、血光、貪墨、意外一類斷語不用；天刑、天月、天巫、龍池鳳閣、三台八座等引擎冇嘅星不用；天機見 tianji-guanlu.json（試點）。

rules.text: 天梁化祿，最適合財務稽核一類工作；工作與財務無關的話，反因財受困擾。
rules.en: Tian Liang in Abundance suits financial audit work best; if your work has nothing to do with money, money brings you trouble instead.

source.quote: 若从事财务稽核之职者，最为适宜

rules.text: 天梁化權，你利於權威性的工作，例如法律、監察。
rules.en: Tian Liang in Authority favours work that carries authority, such as law or oversight.

rules.text: 天梁化科，以清貴為宜：先爭取社會地位，財富隨之而來。
rules.en: Tian Liang in Merit: aim for respected rather than lucrative roles; win your standing first and the money follows.

rules.text: 天梁是清貴之星：即使吉星齊會，也較少負行政之責，適合監察、審核、司法一類工作。
rules.en: Tian Liang is a star of respected integrity: even with every helper star, you rarely carry executive duties; oversight, audit or judicial work suits you.
